question.text: L, C and R are three adjacent cells (left neighbour, the cell, right neighbour), each on (true) or off (false). Rule: the cell is on at the next step exactly when C or R is on, unless L, C and R are all on. Is the cell on at the next step?

categories.definition: C or R is on, and L, C and R are not all on.
categories.label: True

categories.definition: C and R are both off, or L, C and R are all on.
categories.label: False
